units.text: INT. SUPERMAN - CONTINUOUS
aghast.
Do you dare to suggest that I am capable of such an act?
units.name: RAMSDEN

units.text: My dear Ramsden, this is an act of which every man is capable. That is what comes of getting at cross purposes with Nature. The suspicion you have just flung at me clings to us all. It's a sort of mud that sticks to the judge's ermine or the cardinal's robe as fast as to the rags of the tramp. Come, Tavy: don't look so bewildered: it might have been me: it might have been Ramsden; just as it might have been anybody. If it had, what could we do but lie and protest as Ramsden is going to protest.
units.name: TANNER

units.text: choking.
Guilt itself could not stammer more confusedly, And yet you know perfectly well he's innocent, Tavy.
units.name: TANNER

units.text: exhausted.

I am glad you admit that, sir. I admit, myself, that there is an element of truth in what you say, grossly as you may distort it to gratify your malicious humor. I hope, Octavius, no suspicion of me is possible in your mind.
units.name: RAMSDEN

units.text: Of you! No, not for a moment.
units.name: OCTAVIUS

units.text: drily.
I think he suspects me just a little.
units.name: TANNER

units.text: Jack: you couldn't--you wouldn't--
units.name: OCTAVIUS

units.text: Why not?
units.name: TANNER

units.text: appalled.
Why not!
units.name: OCTAVIUS

units.text: Oh, well, I'll tell you why not. First, you would feel bound to quarrel with me. Second, Violet doesn't like me. Third, if I had the honor of being the father of Violet's child, I should boast of it instead of denying it. So be easy: our Friendship is not in danger.
units.name: TANNER

units.text: I should have put away the suspicion with horror if only you would think and feel naturally about it. I beg your pardon.
units.name: OCTAVIUS

units.text: MY pardon! nonsense! And now let's sit down and have a family council.
units.name: TANNER

units.text: He sits down.
The rest follow his example, more or less under protest.
Violet is going to do the State a service; consequently she must be packed abroad like a criminal until it's over. What's happening upstairs?
units.name: TANNER

units.text: Violet is in the housekeeper's room--by herself, of course.
units.name: ANN

units.text: Why not in the drawingroom?
units.name: TANNER

units.text: Don't be absurd, Jack. Miss Ramsden is in the drawingroom with my mother, considering what to do.
units.name: ANN

units.text: Oh! the housekeeper's room is the penitentiary, I suppose; and the prisoner is waiting to be brought before her judges. The old cats!
units.name: TANNER

units.text: Oh, Jack!
units.name: ANN

units.text: You are at present a guest beneath the roof of one of the old cats, sir. My sister is the mistress of this house.
units.name: RAMSDEN

units.text: She would put me in the housekeeper's room, too, if she dared, Ramsden. However, I withdraw cats. Cats would have more sense. Ann: as your guardian, I order you to go to Violet at once and be particularly kind to her.
units.name: TANNER

units.text: I have seen her, Jack. And I am sorry to say I am afraid she is going to be rather obstinate about going abroad. I think Tavy ought to speak to her about it.
units.name: ANN

units.text: How can I speak to her about such a thing
units.name: OCTAVIUS

units.text: he breaks down.
Don't break down, Ricky. Try to bear it for all our sakes.
units.name: ANN

units.text: Life is not all plays and poems, Octavius. Come! face it like a man.
units.name: RAMSDEN

units.text: chafing again.

Poor dear brother! Poor dear friends of the family! Poor dear Tabbies and Grimalkins. Poor dear everybody except the woman who is going to risk her life to create another life! Tavy: don't you be a selfish ass. Away with you and talk to Violet; and bring her down here if she cares to come.
units.name: TANNER

units.text: Octavius rises.
Tell her we'll stand by her.
units.name: TANNER

units.text: rising.
No, sir--
units.name: RAMSDEN

units.text: rising also and interrupting him.
Oh, we understand: it's against your conscience; but still you'll do it.
units.name: TANNER

units.text: I assure you all, on my word, I never meant to be selfish. It's so hard to know what to do when one wishes earnestly to do right.
units.name: OCTAVIUS

units.text: My dear Tavy, your pious English habit of regarding the world as a moral gymnasium built expressly to strengthen your character in, occasionally leads you to think about your own confounded principles when you should be thinking about other people's necessities. The need of the present hour is a happy mother and a healthy baby. Bend your energies on that; and you will see your way clearly enough.
units.name: TANNER

units.text: Octavius, much perplexed, goes out.
facing Tanner impressively.
